title: Remove duplicate FI layer files
summary: Two redundant FI layer source files that duplicated W1 content are removed to reduce maintenance overhead.
key_points: Files were compiler-token equivalent to W1 counterparts
Materialized FI view inherits W1 sources after removal
Reduces risk of drift between duplicate files
quote: The FI layer contains country or region sources that are compiler-token equivalent to their W1 counterparts.
